notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
3 new levels:
Death Deck
Pain Pit
Peril

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
- All monster deaths count toward level kills, which includes in-fighting.

- Fixed a bug in which transparent materials were used as occluders.

- Fixed a bug in which monsters spotted the player through walls.

notes.title: Hellbreaker Update
notes.notes:
- Steam workshop support ([url=https://virhex.com/docs/hellbreaker/mods/#steam-workshop]item creation instructions[/url])

- Improved visibility of monsters and pickups

- Improvements to the levels

- Plasma gun: new sound and increased kickback animation

- increase pickup collision detection size

- Increased sound gain for medal & deadline failure

- bug fixes

- Minor optimizations
